description: This file defines the CardReaderFragment class, which is a UI component in an Android app responsible for NFC card reading. It manages NFC reader mode, handles lifecycle events, and updates the UI with account info received via NFC.

classes.name: CardReaderFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that handles NFC card reading and displays account info on the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, called when created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view and initializes UI components and NFC reader.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Called when the fragment is paused; disables NFC reader mode.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Called when the fragment resumes; enables NFC reader mode.

methods.name: enableReaderMode
methods.description: Enables NFC reader mode with specific flags.

methods.name: onAccountReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when an NFC card account is read; updates UI with the account info.
